change: Compute the same scalar pressure predicate from the borrowed current snapshot under the existing state lock. Return the same configuration and metric copies and static reason. Remove the full previous-host clone, preserving pressure order, adaptive gating, diagnostic values and refresh cadence. No persistent cache, dependency or timer.
diagnostic_scope: Source-extracted exact pressure/context bodies and real locked model/mutex types; standalone diagnostic, not whole-engine/app compilation. Separate default-allocator native executable for CPU, instrumented executable for requested allocations. Every fixture preserves full config/metric/reason values and input snapshot bytes. Standalone opt-level=3/codegen-units=1 with LTO off: cached archives lack embedded bitcode for a separate whole-program LTO link. This diagnostic is not a production-profile comparison.

normal_validation.scope: All normal core release unit/integration/doc tests after borrowing the pressure-check host snapshot. Production release profile unchanged (MCP8, other crates1); no private fixture in canonical source. Exact emitted native cases and normal ignored cases verified; strict all-target Clippy and formatting. One Cargo job; absolute validation cost, not performance comparison.

cost.rss_note: 1s aggregate process-tree RSS samples; shared pages may be counted twice; short peaks may be missed

recovery: Standalone LTO link first failed because retained archives lack embedded bitcode. The original failed receipt is retained; both private diagnostic executables use LTO off and the same exact dependency archives. Production release LTO and flags are unchanged. Normal core release tests validate the actual profile.
limitations: A source-extracted helper diagnostic with real model/mutex types is not the complete engine/app binary or a production-profile performance comparison.
Allocation counts and requested bytes are not RSS or physical footprint. No measured app-wide CPU, memory or wakeup improvement is inferred.
Only a few microseconds per synthetic check are removed. Whole-app profiling is needed to prioritize larger costs.
The pressure predicate now runs inside the existing lock; it reads only scalar fields and performs constant-time arithmetic, replacing the larger clone formerly performed while locked.
The complete app/runtime pipeline will be verified after the next scoped MCP transport fix rather than recompiling it twice.
